cards.name: Dragon Protector of Nature

effects.lua_implementation: Synchro procedure accepts one unrestricted Tuner and one or more non-Tuner Synchro monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Near-exact Tuner plus Synchro-monster material procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If Synchro Summoned using a NATURE Tuner: Special Summon a Level 4 or lower NATURE from Deck/GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Material inspection requires a Tuner with custom attribute bit 0x80; the trigger summons a Level 4-or-lower 0x80 monster from Deck/GY under id HOPT.
effects.issue: NATURE (0x80) is a CCG custom Attribute and has no official Omega card-effect analogue; only the material inspection and Deck/GY summon components match official patterns.

effects.printed_clause: Opponent cannot target NATURE monsters you control with card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: Field cannot-target effect covers controlled 0x80 monsters and uses aux.tgoval.

official_references.matched_structure: Opponent-only archetypal/attribute target protection field effect.

effects.printed_clause: All opponent monsters must attack this card, if able.
effects.lua_implementation: Two official-style field effects now work together: EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK compels each opponent monster to declare an attack if able, and EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK_MONSTER requires this card as the attack target.

official_references.matched_structure: Exact printed attack compulsion implemented with both EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK and EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK_MONSTER.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK_MONSTER alone selected the required target only if the opponent chose to attack; it did not compel attack declarations.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed the missing attack compulsion. The NATURE-attribute material/summon clause remains an unresolved custom-reference gap because 0x80 has no official Omega analogue.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
